text: ポケモン　２ひきも　もってるの　なぜか　だって？

structure.jp: ポケモン　２ひきも　もってるの
structure.en: that I have two whole Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜だって
patterns.explanation: だって at the end repeats back what the other person just said, with surprise. なぜか　だって = 'why, you ask?'

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing you can talk about. もってるの = 'the fact that I have them'.

patterns.name: 〜も (as many as)
patterns.explanation: も after a number says the number feels like a lot. ２ひきも = 'as many as two'.
